text: Warner Music Group priced its IPO on June 3, 2020 at $25 a share and closed its first day at $30.12. The stock peaked at $49.53 on October 28, 2021, fell to a low of $22.35 on October 10, 2022, and closed the five years at $26.21 on June 9, 2025, 4.8% above the offer price, before dividends. Its filings show solid revenue growth that slowed as currency and economic headwinds hit, with cash flow under pressure.
